title: Debata Ama Di Surgo
chord: Em · G · C · D · Em · Am · D7 · E
lyrics:
Debata Ama na di Surgo i
Na manompa daging nang tondingki
Ho do oloanku saleleng ngolungku
Pujionku do tongtong GoarMi
Jesus Kristus Debata Anak i
Sipalua jolma pardosa i

Ho do oloanku saleleng ngolungku
Pujionku do tongtong GoarMi
Tondi Parbadia Debatangki
Na manjou au tu hangoluan i
Ho do oloanku saleleng ngolungku
Pujionku do tongtong GoarMi

Debatangku Sitolu sada i
Ama, Anak, Tondi na songkal i
Ho do oloanku saleleng ngolungku
Pujionku do tongtong GoarMi
